tasks.title: Merge many dictionaries
tasks.statement: Write a function merge_all(dicts) that merges a list of dictionaries into one; when keys collide, the dictionary that comes later in the list wins. Use reduce (the initial value is an empty dictionary).

tasks.title: A number parser
tasks.statement: Write a function int_parser(base) that returns a function converting a string to an integer in the given base. Use functools.partial.

tasks.title: Fast Fibonacci
tasks.statement: Write a recursive function fib(n) returning the n-th Fibonacci number (fib(0) = 0, fib(1) = 1). Without a cache it won't finish in time for large n, so add the lru_cache decorator.
tasks.hint: @lru_cache(maxsize=None) above def fib(n): return n if n < 2 else fib(n - 1) + fib(n - 2).

tasks.title: Sort by two fields
tasks.statement: Write a function sort_people(people), where people is a list of dictionaries {'city': ..., 'age': ...}. Sort by city (alphabetically), and for equal cities by age (ascending). Use operator.itemgetter with two keys.

tasks.title: A class with total_ordering
tasks.statement: Define a class Card(rank) with the total_ordering decorator: define only __eq__ and __lt__ (by rank), and the other comparisons (<=, >, >=) must start working by themselves.
tasks.hint: @total_ordering above the class; __eq__: compare the ranks; __lt__: self.rank < other.rank.

tasks.title: Overloading by type
tasks.statement: Write a function describe(x) using singledispatch: for int return «целое <x>», for str return «строка из <n> символов», for list return «список из <n> элементов», for everything else return «что-то». Output the Russian texts exactly as quoted, with <x> and <n> replaced by the value and the length.
tasks.hint: @singledispatch above the base describe; @describe.register(int) def _(x): ... and the same for str and list.

tasks.title: Sorting through a comparison
tasks.statement: Write a function sort_words(words): shorter words first, and for equal lengths alphabetically. Implement it with a function comparing two words and functools.cmp_to_key.
tasks.hint: compare returns a negative number, 0 or a positive number; sorted(words, key=cmp_to_key(compare)).

tasks.title: A table column
tasks.statement: Write a function column(rows, i) returning the list of values in the i-th column of a table (rows is a list of lists). Use map and operator.itemgetter.
